answer: Admission occurs through a ceremony where agents provide proof of one ferrous physical anchor to gain access. Participants mirror their state to a verifier which rejects duplicate graph edges. An honest entity costs 1 unit; 1,000 fakes incur a 1,000-fold ferrous load as the verifier hits a nadir of trust. Each identity must mirror its history to avoid being at the nadir of protocol security, ensuring costs remain high for any sybil actor.
